text:
In gardens still, the wild winds sigh,
Beneath the watchful, leafy sky.
The blossoms wake, their secrets told,
In petals bright, a story old.

The ancient trees, in silence stand,
Guardians of the shifting land.
Their rustling leaves, a whispered tale,
Of time’s long, unrelenting sail.

Here peace is found in roots and rain,
In life’s sweet cycle, joy and pain.
Each bloom, each leaf, a fleeting sign,
Of nature’s grand, eternal line.

The animal with distinctive black and white stripes is the zebra.
